gap: No result ChatGPT got states which earbud cases charge on a Qi pad: the Shokz OpenFit 2 case is USB-C only (only the $199.95 OpenFit 2+ adds Qi), the 1st-gen Bose Ultra Open needs a $49 case cover (the $299 2nd Gen has it built in), and the soundcore AeroFit 2 case charges wirelessly. Also, turning on LDAC on the AeroFit 2 switches off multipoint, and iPhones can't use LDAC.

decides: This confirms the AeroFit 2 as the open-ear pick for shoppers who own a Qi pad, and Dealectric lists ESR and UGREEN Qi2 pads to pair with it. For anyone who wants wireless charging from Shokz, the row should become the OpenFit 2+ (+$20) instead of the OpenFit 2. The Bose row should move to the Ultra Open (2nd Gen, $299), which has wireless charging and Snapdragon Sound with aptX Adaptive on compatible Android phones. iPhone owners should know LDAC on the soundcore models won't work for them, and Android owners who switch LDAC on lose multipoint on the AeroFit 2.
